subject: ClearBay pricing - cost anchor & early-stage credit path
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Ella Simmons <ella@clearbay.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Quick follow-up: ClearBay cost profile & next steps

Hi Ella — great to meet today. Short recap + two asks so we can move toward a pilot: 

Recap from our call (ClearBay / Redwood):
- Primary workload: production embeddings + chat-based reranking for search; majority is short-context inference (<=256 tokens), some longer generation flows (~1k tokens) used by internal prototypes.
- Current estimates: 20M tokens/month baseline; expected growth to ~45–60M tokens/month over Q3 if the pilot proves out.
- Target unit economics: ClearBay is aiming for an effective cost around $120 per 1M tokens once steady-state. Budget for first 12 months is in the range of $85k–$140k depending on growth.

What you asked for on the call:
1) A clear cost anchor (list vs. committed) with example $/1M token math for their expected bands.
2) A startup program path (credits or early-stage discount) to bridge the pilot -> commit decision.
3) A simple committed-use illustration for 12 vs 24 months and what the uplift to multi-year incentives looks like.

Two asks for you / your procurement contact to unblock next week:
1) Can you confirm the 20M/month baseline and whether you expect any immediate spikes to 80M+ in peak test windows? If so, when.
2) Share procurement email for PO timing and whether ClearBay prefers a 12- or 24-month commitment window.

I attached a one-pager and the MAU estimate spreadsheet so we can model the bands. I’ll loop Rishi and Monica in to draft a concise pricing path (trial credits + committed options).

Thanks — talk soon.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com | (415) 555-0134

Attachments: clearbay_mau_estimates.xlsx, redwood_pricing_walkthrough.pdf
From: Ella Simmons <ella@clearbay.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearbay.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: ClearBay cost profile & next steps

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the thorough recap. Confirming: baseline 20M tokens/month, short-term test spikes up to 75M for 48–72 hour evaluation runs (usually once per quarter). We expect the pilot to live in production for 6–12 weeks before we make a commit decision.

For procurement: procurement@clearbay.ai is the right inbox — they handle PO timing and contract review. For commercial preference: we’d like to see both 12- and 24-month committed options, with a clear comparison to no-commit (on-demand) pricing.

Two asks from our side: 
- Can Redwood provide a starter credit for early-stage customers (either a fixed credit or % off first $X spend)? That will allow us to run the 6–8 week integration tests without exhausting our slug of dev budget.
- Need to understand the SLOs and fallback model (if you have cheaper model variants that we can failover to when capacity constrained).

If you can send a short proposal with the anchors and effective $/1M math we’ll loop procurement and legal.

—Ella
Ella Simmons
Head of ML Ops, ClearBay AI
ella@clearbay.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: (internal)
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -0500
Subject: FW: ClearBay pricing - need starter credit + committed-use illustration

Rishi / Monica — quick internal: ClearBay confirmed baseline/peaks and asked for two things: a starter credit for the pilot and a clear 12- vs 24-month committed banded pricing table with effective $/1M numbers. Procurement is procurement@clearbay.ai.

Suggested approach (draft):
- Trial: $10k Redwood credit applied to first 8 weeks of usage (covers ~50–60% of their pilot spend at baseline).
- On-demand (no commit) list: $200 / 1M tokens (baseline for short-context workloads on our curated open models).
- 12-month commit: 25% discount off list -> $150 / 1M effective.
- 24-month commit: 35% discount off list -> $130 / 1M effective + option to lock pricing for year 2 without a usage floor step-up.
- Volume bands (applied on top of committed discounts): 0–10M, 10–50M, >50M with incremental price breaks of $10 / 1M per band for large volumes (e.g., top band could be another $10–20 off).

Questions for approval / alignment:
1) Are the 25% / 35% discounts acceptable for a mid-stage startup account that projects ~20M -> 50M tokens/mo?
2) We should confirm whether to make the trial credit payable only on onboarding (no refund) vs. credited back after invoice reconciliation — any preference?
3) Any constraints on offering the 24-month deeper discount to a company that wants a short 6–12 week validation first? We could require a letter of intent and PO to secure the band.

I attached a quick model (pricing_model_clearbay_v1.xlsx) that maps spend bands to effective monthly spend. If this looks okay I’ll convert to a customer-facing one-page proposal and send to Ella + procurement.

—Lauren
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Ella Simmons <ella@clearbay.ai>, procurement@clearbay.ai
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:34:00 -0500
Subject: Proposal: ClearBay pilot credit + committed-use pricing anchors (short)

Hi Ella / procurement team — following up with a concise proposal so you can route to legal/finance. I kept this deliberately short; PDF + model attached.

Proposal highlights (pilot -> commit):
1) Starter credit (pilot): one-time $10,000 Redwood credit applied to invoices covering the first 8 weeks post-onboarding. Credit is non-refundable and used against consumption. This is intended to cover initial integration + evaluation usage.

2) Pricing anchors (list / committed):
- On-demand (no commit): list price $200 per 1M tokens (short-context, production-optimized models).
- 12-month committed-use (minimum 20M tokens/month commit averaged over 12 months): 25% off list -> effective $150 / 1M tokens.
- 24-month committed-use (minimum 15M tokens/month commit averaged over 24 months): 35% off list -> effective $130 / 1M tokens + ability to anchor year-2 pricing at the same rate.

3) Volume band adders (applies after commit discount):
- 0–10M /mo: no additional band discount (base effective price).
- 10–50M /mo: additional $10 off per 1M (e.g., 12-mo band effective ~$140 / 1M).
- >50M /mo: additional $20 off per 1M (e.g., 12-mo band effective ~$130 / 1M).

4) SLA & failover notes: Redwood offers a fallback policy to a compatible model variant (lower-cost tier) during capacity constraints; we will document expected latency SLOs in the final SOW.

Next steps if this aligns with ClearBay: 
- Procurement confirms preference for 12 vs 24-month commitment and sends standard PO template to procurement@redwood.com.
- We produce a short commercial summary and attach the 12/24-month term language for legal review (we can also put the 24-month deeper discount behind a LOI to protect Redwood).
- Sign via DocuSign link (included) or return PO + signed SOW.

Attachments: pricing_model_clearbay_v1.xlsx, redwood_pricing_walkthrough.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-3471
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/clearbay-proposal-3471

If you want tighter unit math for a specific growth path I can drop in the month-by-month schedule from the attached model. Happy to hop on a 20-minute follow to walk the numbers.

—Lauren
